Subject: Re: Unexpected per-route cost spike — need breakdown and plan

Attaching initial export and query template. Summary below.

Summary (Oct 1–9):
- POST /v1/generate: 2.7M input tokens, 5.9M output tokens (cost up 2.8x vs Sep avg)
- POST /v1/chat: stable
- Embeddings/other: unchanged

Observations:
- No model rollouts logged for your tenant between Oct 1–9.
- We have several high-latency tails on the /v1/generate route from seq_len>1024 requests that push token consumption when full context is echoed back.

Immediate mitigations (quick wins):
- Enable prefix/KV caching for the tenant (saves ~30–60% on repeated prompts) — requires a flag flip and 15 min to validate.
- Apply an output-token cap for the route for two weeks (e.g., max 512) — can be enforced in routing config.
- Configure batching window to 8ms to reduce per-token cost at slight latency tradeoff.

I've attached route_query_template.csv (one sheet, column headers: route, start_ts, end_ts, input_tokens, output_tokens, model_variant, region, rollout_tag) — please populate any client-side changes in the sheet so we can correlate.

Attachment: route_query_template.csv (CSV)

I'll be on the Thu Oct 15 10:00 PT slot.

Thanks,
